name: qtruncnorm
title: Quantile by Brent's zeroin. An infinite bound is stepped in until the bracket is finite.

origin.description: Quantile by Brent's zeroin. An infinite bound is stepped in until the bracket is finite.
origin.details: Quantiles on a finite interval, a right-truncated normal, and a left-truncated normal.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(truncnorm))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", qtruncnorm(c(0.25, 0.5, 0.9), c(-1, -Inf, -1), c(2, 1, Inf))), collapse = ","))
